title: After graduation in the UK: work, visas and a plan before expiry
summary: Check your course, job offer and visa dates. Compare lawful options and make a backup plan if sponsorship has not come through.
content:
# After graduation in the UK: work, visas and a plan before expiry

Last updated: 2026-11-26

## Start with three dates
If you are finishing a UK course on Student permission, note your official course end and expected successful-completion report, the expiry date on your eVisa or any later UKVI notice, and the start date of any job offer. Ask the university visa team when they will tell UKVI you have passed. A ceremony, final submission and completion report are different events. [Graduate eligibility](#guide-evidence-dates)

## Compare the options you can act on
If you have a genuine eligible job, ask the employer for the sponsoring legal entity, occupation code, salary, hours, proposed start date and Certificate of Sponsorship (CoS) timetable. Check the register and contact HR through the employer's own website. A licence alone does not establish sponsorship for your vacancy. A direct Student-to-Skilled Worker switch can be possible once you meet the Student switching conditions and the job and visa rules. If you still need time to look for work, Graduate permission may give you time if you qualify. It gives no guarantee of a later sponsor. [Switching and checking sponsors](#guide-evidence-offers) · [Graduate Visa timing](/en/work-visa/graduate-visa-uk) · [Skilled Worker sponsorship](/en/work-visa/skilled-worker-sponsorship-cos)

## Look beyond one graduate scheme
Use your university careers office and alumni network. Many structured graduate schemes start recruiting in autumn, while other vacancies open throughout the year. Compare actual start dates. On a UK CV, show what you did and the result. Prepare short examples for interview and check your visa conditions before taking an internship. Ask HR separately about your right to work now and their willingness to sponsor this role later. [Careers timelines](#guide-evidence-careers)

## Check alternatives against your own circumstances
For health roles, check the exact occupation, employer and any required professional registration. Adult social care has separate restrictions. Innovator Founder requires endorsement for a qualifying business. “Self-sponsorship” is a marketing label for arrangements under other rules. There is no standalone visa with that name. Owning a company does not give permission to work for it. Global Talent requires qualifying evidence or an eligible prize. Scale-up needs a qualifying sponsored offer at the start. A UK degree does not qualify for High Potential Individual. Follow the family route only where an existing genuine relationship or dependant circumstances meet its rules. For further study, ask the university about CAS, academic progression and the cost before committing. [Official route criteria](#guide-evidence-alternatives) · [Partner routes](/en/family-visa/partner-visa-routes-overview)

## Keep settlement calculations separate
If you held Graduate permission for 2 years and then Skilled Worker permission for 3 years, that is only 3 years towards the ordinary 5-year Skilled Worker qualifying period under the rules reviewed. Both lawful periods may count towards the separate 10-year long-residence route if its rules are met. Keep permission dates and absences. Broad earned-settlement policy announcements and individually dated rule changes need separate checks. [Settlement rules](#guide-evidence-residence) · [Long residence](/en/settlement/settlement-long-residence)

## If your permission is close to expiry
Suppose your results are due after your Student permission expires and HR has made only a verbal promise. Ask the university and an appropriately regulated adviser promptly what valid options remain. An offer or saved form gives no right to stay. When section 3C applies after an in-time valid application, it generally continues your existing conditions while a decision is pending. Check your work and travel position before acting. If you have no lawful basis to remain, plan to leave before expiry. Apply in parallel for suitable roles in your home country or elsewhere, arrange references and save course and visa records. You may be able to apply to return under a future route if you then qualify. [Pending permission and adviser search](#guide-evidence-contingency)

## Protect your money and documents
Refuse offers to buy a CoS or pay someone to guarantee a job or visa. Verify contact details independently, keep messages and receipts privately and use official reporting channels for suspected fraud. Seek regulated advice promptly if there is a refusal, cancellation, expiry problem or exploitation. [Reporting and support](#guide-evidence-fraud) · [National Insurance number](/en/money/national-insurance-number-newcomers) · [Understanding UK payslips](/en/money/uk-paye-tax-codes-national-insurance)
